cases.title: Water and a Gun

cases.title: The Second Alarm
cases.setup: Priya sets a loud kitchen alarm for five minutes after her bedside one. Every morning she races to stop it before it sounds. The night her power failed, she chose to sleep at a friend's house instead.
cases.solution: Priya lives alone after collapsing once, undetected for hours. Her neighbour listens each morning: if Priya is well she reaches the kitchen and stops the second alarm before it sounds; if it rings on, she may be unable to get up and needs help. Without power the safeguard could fail, so she stayed with a friend.
